description: Quality tier (needs a real provider + LLM judge). The agent answers a question about the practice lab; autoevals.Factuality scores the answer against the docs/lab.md catalog. Judge is nondeterministic, so the threshold is conservative.

cases.prompt: On the practice lab web app, which endpoint is vulnerable to numeric SQL injection, and which parameter?
cases.expected: post.php, via the id parameter (?id=), UNION-based numeric SQL injection

cases.prompt: The lab's users table stores raw-md5 password hashes. What is the admin account's cracked password?
Which post ids on the lab blog are hidden and readable via IDOR on post.php?
cases.expected: id 4 (draft) and id 5 (private), readable via post.php?id=N with no visibility check

cases.prompt: Where on the lab web app can the full password-hash dump be downloaded directly?
How can login on the lab be bypassed with SQL injection to reach an admin session?
cases.expected: username admin'-- - with any password on login.php bypasses authentication into an admin session
